Title: New feature in public preview for intelligent ingestion from Event Hubs source

Body.Content:
Azure Data Explorer (ADX) offers ingestion from Event Hubs, a big-data streaming platform and event ingestion service that processes millions of events per second in near real-time.

ADX ingestion can now intelligently suggest the relevant table schema and mapping definitions according to the Event Hubs source in just 4 steps:

  1. Define Event Hubs as source
  2. ADX intelligently suggests the relevant table schema
  3. Adjust table schema, if needed
  4. Table, Mapping and Event Hubs data connection for continuous ingestion are defined with one click

To connect Event Hubs with ADX, use ADX web explorer to configure end-to-end ingestion easily and accurately.

Learn more.
